actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong, FDR-significant pathway enrichment (e.g., HEME_METABOLISM, PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS, COAGULATION) and large effect sizes. WXS and CNV are not significant but do not actively contradict the RNA signal. Technical confounding is not significant at set level, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 lacks coherent positive identity evidence: no significant RNA pathways, no significant mutations, and no significant CNV features after FDR correction. Cross-modal consistency is modest but not strong, and technical confounding is not significant. The absence of a coherent biological identity and lack of any strong modality support make retention indefensible; Drop is better supported than Accept, and there is no positive evidence for Split or Merge.

C0003 shows a coherent biological identity with significant RNA pathways (PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS, HEME_METABOLISM), a significant CNV feature (chr20q), and a strong PBRM1 mutation enrichment trend (OR=4.07, p=0.009) that is biologically plausible for ccRCC. Although PBRM1 does not survive FDR, the combined evidence across modalities supports a defensible candidate. Technical confounding is not significant, and structural evidence does not support Split or Merge. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0004 has a strong RNA-defined identity with 16 significant pathways, including downregulation of immune/inflammatory pathways (ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION, TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB) and upregulation of HEME_METABOLISM, with large effect sizes. WXS and CNV are not significant but do not contradict the RNA signal. Technical confounding is not significant at set level, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0005 is heavily confounded by technical factors: multiple set-level technical associations are significant after FDR correction (e.g., tissue_source_site B8, ct_phase NEPH, ct_manufacturer SIEMENS, ct_reconstruction_kernel STANDARD). The biological evidence is weak (no significant RNA or CNV, only nominal FLG mutation enrichment). The technical associations plausibly explain the observed structure, and there is no strong biological identity to separate from this alternative explanation. Drop is better supported than Accept, and there is no positive evidence for Split or Merge.

C0006 has a coherent RNA-defined identity with a strong EMT signal (SMD=1.40, q=0.008) and nominal BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR=7.56, p=0.014) that is biologically plausible. Although the set is small and other modalities are not significant, the EMT pathway is a strong, coherent biological program. Technical confounding is not significant, and structural evidence does not support Split or Merge. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0007 has a strong RNA-defined identity with 14 significant pathways, including downregulation of MYOGENESIS and WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING and upregulation of inflammatory pathways, with large effect sizes. BAP1 mutation enrichment is nominal (q=0.097) and biologically plausible. Technical confounding is not significant, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0008 has only 2 members, making all analyses underpowered and unreliable. No significant findings in any modality, and internal structure cannot be estimated. The set lacks sufficient evidence to define a coherent biological identity, and there is no positive evidence for Split or Merge. Drop is better supported than Accept.
